notes.body: @zoranbosnjak Wireshark's master branch is failing to compile after updating the Asterix specifications. I'm going to disable that part of the weekly update script in order to allow the other updates to be merged in.
I think that the failures are in one of the tests.

Indeed, the problem is with the test. There was a minor change in asterix spec 048, latest edition. It looks like the test automatically selects latest edition (it should be fixed to a particular edition).

Anyway, please apply this patch and try to re-enable updates.

```diff
diff --git a/test/suite_dissectors/group_asterix.py b/test/suite_dissectors/group_asterix.py
index 7435d24b0a..a8b3d301c2 100644
--- a/test/suite_dissectors/group_asterix.py
+++ b/test/suite_dissectors/group_asterix.py
@@ -1580,9 +1580,9 @@ class TestCategory048:
             dict_local(x_090, "048_090", "FL", "2047.75")
         )
         validator.add_dissection(
-            [0x04, 0x20, 0x00],
+            [0x04, 0x10, 0x00],
             "asterix.048_090",
-            dict_local(x_090, "048_090", "FL", "2048")
+            dict_local(x_090, "048_090", "FL", "1024")
         )
         validator.add_dissection(
             [0x02, 0x80, 0xff],
```
